acceptanceCriteria: A1: Workspace package metadata and Cargo.lock resolve consistently to v0.2.16, and release tag identity is derived from Cargo metadata.
A2: English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese release/version/distribution documentation name v0.2.16 as the current immutable baseline without stale current-version examples.
A3: Release source-quality, workflow-policy, version-consistency, conformance, performance, and adopter acceptance static gates pass without source fallback or global configuration writes.
A4: Public Release assets, manifest, checksums, SBOM, provenance, Homebrew formula, and post-release adopter/N-1 acceptance bind the same tag, commit, runtime version, and binary digest.
A5: Installed v0.2.16 is used to inspect, status, doctor, agent doctor, verify, and render Outcome for this repository after release; no active Work Item remains.
goal: Bump the workspace to v0.2.16, update the current release documentation baseline, pass release gates, and produce a public Release candidate without changing repository governance semantics.
intent: Prepare and publish the next immutable Runtime release after merged verification-route and Outcome archive fixes, keeping release identity, documentation, and installation evidence consistent.
